title: Sr. Product Manager (m/w/x)
description:
About Grover
 Founded in 2015, Grover enables consumers and businesses across Europe to subscribe to tech devices and comprehensive technology solutions - from individual smartphones, laptops, and wearables to full corporate device setups. The company offers access to over 1,000 unique tech items on flexible and financially convenient terms. A pioneer of the circular economy, Grover refurbishes and recirculates devices to help eliminate e-waste.
 To continue this incredible adventure, we are currently looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our talented Commercial team, full-time (40 hours/week) and a minimum 3 days per week (Tuesday-Thursday) at our Berlin HQ. 
 In this role, you will report to and work closely with the Principal PM for Circular Supply Chain, who owns the procurement, fulfillment, return, grading, channeling, repair and resale. Grover's economics are not defined by a single transaction. They are defined by how many times the same physical device earns for us. If a device only earns once, our plan does not hold. If it earns two or three times, it does. This works only when we have a spine that holds a record of every asset we own that we can actually trust. Where it is, what condition it is in, which contract it sits on, what it is worth and what happened to it last. Today that record is spread across multiple systems including warehousing, third-party logistics providers, and a set of legacy systems that each hold part of the truth.You will own that record, and the systems that maintain it. This is the Asset Lifecycle Management platform: the asset registry, the reconciliation, the return-to-rentable loop, and the monitoring and tooling that keeps it honest at scale.
  🎯 What you will contribute: 
 Own the asset registry and the lifecycle it records : Bring the asset lifecycle onto a single source of truth. Define the asset state model, the events that move an asset between states, and the contracts between the systems that emit them. 
 Stock Availability: E2E device lifecycle handling via different sources of truth within Grover eco-system breaks in several places and each break is stock we own but cannot sell. You will close the gaps and ensure we show the stock available to end customers when we hold them in our warehouses.
 Internal tooling to support asset operations: Proactive alerts, monitoring and internal tooling; so that the exceptions like - a lost device, a quarantined unit, a stuck reservation, a unit that never came back - are detected and resolved by a system rather than a spreadsheet. Your job is to keep turning manual, human-in-the-loop operations into automated, rule-based services.
 Own the finance and procurement interfaces: Asset cost, net book value, capitalisation and depreciation flow between the asset platform and the general ledger. You will specify what the asset platform needs from finance systems and hold a clean interface, rather than letting business logic leak across the boundary.
 Be the API-as-a-product owner for the warehouse and logistics integrations: Operational Logistics owns the commercial relationship with our partners. You own the technical integration, the data contracts and the systems logic that executes our business needs inside their four walls - including, over time, the WMS integration for our own warehouse.
 Vendor Management: Parts of this landscape are delivered with an external implementation partner. You will own the requirements, the acceptance criteria and the testing that decide whether what they delivered is what we asked for.
 🤝 What you bring: 
 System-of-record migration track record: You have run a system-of-record migration: You have moved a business off a system that held the truth about something valuable, onto one that holds it better, while the business kept running. You know what dual-running, cutover, backfill and reconciliation actually cost.
 Domain fluency: You are fluent in a relevant domain. Supply chain, reverse logistics, e-commerce fulfilment, re-commerce, rental or asset finance. You understand that a physical asset behaves differently from a row in a database, and that the difference is where the bugs live. (A plus if you have experience in rental, leasing, subscription or circular business, where the same asset is sold more than once.) 
 Self-sufficient, AI-augmented data skills: You are self-sufficient with data. In the world of AI, you use AI tolling as your partner in driving data, reports and analytics and very much cater as an analyst to guide yourself and take informed decisions backed up by data.
 Automated operations & configurable decisioning: You have shipped rules or decisioning products that the business operates. Not a rules engine that only engineering can change. Something an operations or commercial team configures, with the guardrails, audit trail and versioning that makes that safe.
 API-as-a-product mindset: You have an API-as-a-product mindset. Your users are other engineers, operations teams and external partners. You know how to define a data contract, version it, document it and support it.
 Vendor & Systems Integrator governance: You have held a vendor or systems integrator to a contract. You can write requirements precise enough to be tested against, and you are comfortable being the person who says this is not what we specified.
 Pragmatic brownfield execution: You are a pragmatic operator in a brownfield. You are not intimidated by legacy. You can balance the new build against the reality, and you would rather agree on a descope in advance than discover it in March.
 System-to-stakeholder translation: You communicate with clarity and structure. You can take a genuinely complicated system and make it legible to an engineer, an operations lead and an executive, in the language each of them needs.
 Bonus points: if you have experience with ERP interfaces - S/4 HANA, Navision or similar - from the operational side rather than the f

title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
description:
Berlin
Full-time
Permanent employee
**What we do**
--------------
At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.
Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.
Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.
After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.
If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.
**What you'll be doing**
------------------------
You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.
You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.
We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.
We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.
**Own the wealth product area end to end**
* Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
* Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
* Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
* Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
**Turn the data into something users act on**
* Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
* Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
* Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway
**Own the numbers**
* Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
* Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
* Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you
**What we are looking for**
---------------------------
**You might be a fit if:**
* You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
* You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
* You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality.
* You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice.
* Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
* You're fluent in English; German is a plus
* You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany
That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts.
**Strong plus if you have:**
* PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
* Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
* Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
* Subscription and paywall experimentation
* Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
* Your own portfolio, and opinions about it
If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.
**Work authorisation**
**This role requires an existing right to work in Germany.** We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.
**What the first six months look like**
* **Month 1:** you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
* **Months 2 t

title: Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d)
description:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech! At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.   
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d) to help us make Apaleo compliant, fast, wherever we grow next. You'll own the delivery of features that keep our platform compliant across markets, working closely with a Senior Product Management Lead who sets the strategic direction for the wider fiscal and tax domain.   
 What You'll Be Up To   
 Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation.   
 Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against.   
 Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched.   
 Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks.   
 Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting.   
 Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable.   
 Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work.   
 Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years.   
 What You'll Bring to the Team   
 At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment.   
 A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held.   
 Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth.   
 Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day.   
 A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it.   
 Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.   
 Extra Awesome Points For   
 Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement.   
 Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on.   
 What We Offer   
 A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective.   
 A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way.   
 A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich.   
 Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan.   
 Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role.   
 Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations.   
 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge.   
 Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered.   
 How You'll Make an Impact   
 Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see.   
 Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

title: Product Manager, Agents
description:
London, 4x days per week in-office
Vega is looking for A-players who will define and build the next generation of Agentic products that will shape the next era of private markets.
 About Vega
 Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.
Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.
Who we are
We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.
How we do it
Vega Is a Fast-growing Startup. We Want To Make This a Career-accelerating Place For People With The Ambition To Build Something Big. If The Below Sounds Appealing, It Could Be For You
We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.
We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.
We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.
We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.
We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.
We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.
Who succeeds in this role
We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.
 In This Role, You Will
 Lead and partner with engineering teams on technical concepts to deliver exceptional AI-first solutions. Prototype instead of writing specs.
Own an agentic surface end-to-end and decide what runs unattended and what needs a human.
Keep every autonomous action explainable and reversible. Own the tradeoffs on reliability, latency and cost.
Sit with GP and LP ops teams, find the manual work, remove it without breaking their controls.
Operate and deliver with a sense of urgency under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment where multi-tasking, strong communication and problem-solving skills are a must.
 What We Look For
 2+ years in product, ideally somewhere where being wrong is expensive.
Hands-on with prompting, context engineering and evals. You've done it yourself, not managed someone who did.
You've shipped LLM or agent features to real users, and can say what broke.
Enough technical fluency to argue with engineers about retrieval and tool design. Good judgement to know when AI is the wrong answer.
Working with GPs/LPs and/or knowledge of Fund administration, KYC/AML or LP portals is an advantage.
Why join us?
You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team
Competitive salary and equity package
Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

title: Senior Product Manager, Streaming Platform
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
Snowflake is building the platform that teams rely on to make data useful, reliable, and ready for the age of AI. As customers shift from batch analytics to real-time systems and intelligent applications, streaming is becoming core to how data is produced, consumed, and acted upon.
We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead Snowflake’s Streaming Platform. This role is at the center of the real-time data shift, defining how data in motion becomes data that teams can trust, analyze, and use to power AI-driven workflows. Streaming is the backbone for modern applications, operational analytics, and Agent to Agent pipelines.
If you are passionate about distributed systems, care about craft, and want to work on problems that matter at massive scale, this is a rare opportunity to build something foundational.
 What You Will Do
 Product Vision: Own the product direction, strategy, and roadmap for Snowflake’s streaming capabilities.
 Execution: Translate complex customer problems into clear product bets and successfully shipped features.
 Engineering Partnership: Collaborate closely with engineering on system design, trade-offs, and execution.
 User Focus: Spend time with users to understand what is broken, what is missing, and what matters most.
 Design & GTM: Partner with design to ensure advanced workflows are intuitive, and work with GTM teams to launch products that resonate with customers.
 Alignment: Drive cross-functional alignment across ingestion, platform, analytics, and AI teams.
 Prioritization: Make rigorous prioritization calls grounded in impact, scale, and customer value.
 What We Are Looking For
 Experience building products in data infrastructure, distributed systems, or real-time platforms.
 Strong understanding of streaming systems and event-driven architectures.
 Experience working with Flink or similar systems is a strong plus.
 Ability to engage deeply with engineers and reason about architecture and design choices.
 Comfort working in ambiguity and shaping direction from first principles.
 Strong communication skills and a practical, customer-first mindset.
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required.
 Master’s degree is a plus.
 Why Snowflake
 Snowflake is where the world’s hardest data problems are tackled. You will work on systems that run at scale for thousands of customers, with a real impact on how modern companies operate and build AI-powered applications.
You will join a team that values clarity over complexity, speed with responsibility, and technical excellence. Most importantly, you will have the space and influence to build a platform that customers genuinely depend on. If you enjoy working on hard problems and want to shape how data moves and powers intelligence, we’d love to talk.
Snowflake is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
How do you want to make your impact?
For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

title: (Senior) Product Manager (m/f/x)
description:
Who We Are 
 At Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. family, we're on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide.
 By combining world-class clinical expertise with innovative technology, we deliver inclusive, culturally competent support that helps individuals and families navigate some of life's most important journeys.
 With Progyny's support and global reach, we're expanding access to care and breaking down barriers so that more people can build the families they want, wherever they are in the world.
 Role Overview 
 We're looking for an experienced, energetic, AI-forward, and performance driven (Senior) Product Manager to join our Product team in Berlin.
 In this role, you'll take end-to-end ownership of one or more core product capabilities across our member portal and internal operations experience, from discovery and strategy through delivery and iteration. You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, and business stakeholders across Sales, Member Experience, Finance, and Legal to build products that support people through some of life's most sensitive moments.
 This role is ideal for someone who is self-driven and comfortable owning a domain without heavy oversight, who brings structure and clarity to ambiguity, and who communicates decisions and rationale clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences. You thrive in start-up speed and maneuverability, while you take steps to improve and optimize how you and the team work to deliver results. You will be working within a small but mighty product team with Product Management, Content and localization, and design, reporting into our Sr. Director of Global Product.
 Tasks 
 Own multiple product capabilities end to end – from problem definition and discovery through delivery, launch, and ongoing iteration 
 Define product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for your area, in partnership with product leadership, Engineering, and Design 
 Translate ambiguous business and user problems into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria – can include business analyst-like activities 
 Partner closely with Product Designers on user research, journey mapping, and validating solutions before and during build 
 Work closely with Engineering to prioritize the backlog, unblock delivery, and make sound trade-off calls 
 Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Member Experience, Finance, and Legal to align product decisions with operational and business realities 
 Facilitate workshops, stakeholder alignment sessions, and retrospectives 
 Monitor product performance post-launch and drive iteration based on data and user feedback 
 Communicate progress, decisions, and the reasoning behind them clearly and proactively, without needing to be asked 
 Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities in a fast-moving, dynamic environment balancing oversight on changing variables with granular details
 Requirements 
 What You Bring 
 At least 6+ years of experience in Product Management, with a track record of owning a product area or capability end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration 
 Demonstrated ability to work independently and proactively – highly organized, self-driven, and comfortable making progress without close direction 
 Clear, structured communicator, able to explain context, decisions, and trade-offs to stakeholders at all levels 
 Strong experience partnering with Design and Engineering throughout the product development lifecycle 
 Comfortable introducing and shaping ‘best practices’ while balancing with the current organizational context 
 AI-forward mindset, ruthless prioritization and consistent, clear verbal and written communication with stakeholders in English 
 Comfortable defining and tracking success metrics, and using data to inform product decisions 
 Comfortable navigating ambiguity and adapting to change in a fast-moving, scaling environment
 Nice to Have 
 Experience owning workflow-heavy or process-driven capabilities, for example in fintech, insurance, or healthtech (e.g. claims, payments, reimbursement, or similarly regulated operational flows) 
 Familiarity with and affinity for healthcare, wellbeing, or HR technology products 
 Experience working in international teams
 Benefits 
 Why Join Us 
 💰 Competitive Base Salary : From €75,000-85,000 per year.
 🎯 Bonus Program & Company Equity : Bonuses and ownership opportunities to share in Progyny’s success.
 👶 Fertility & Family-Building Benefits : Access to the Progyny Global Platform with a €5,000 benefits budget.
 🧘 Mental Health Support : Eight 1:1 psychologist and coaching sessions and wellness tools via Spring Health.
 🚲 Sustainable Mobility Benefit : Choice between a Dance e-bike subscription or a BVG public transport ticket.
 💪 Urban Sports Club Discount : Access to discounted fitness and wellness activities.
 🌴 Paid Leave : 30 days of paid leave per year.
 🏡 Hybrid Work : Work from home up to two days per week.
 ✈️ Remote Work : Up to 8 weeks of remote work per year.
 🍽️ Weekly Team Lunches : Team lunch every Thursday.
 🐶 Dog Friendly office: Bring your dog to work.
 We believe that great leaders come from diverse backgrounds. If you’re passionate about building high-performing teams, delivering world-class care, and shaping the future of global member experience, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Product Lead - Portfolio Midcore Games
description:
About Voodoo
 Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.
This position is fully remote as long as you can work within CET ±5h CET.
Team
Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.
Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.
You will be joining the Midcore team from Live Studios. Our main mission is converting hypercasual titles into deep midcore games. The studio is also working on Ball Blast , Sniper Siege , Epic Plane , Gear Fight , Archery Clash , Path of Kings & Monster Survivors .
 Role
As Product Lead, you will be one of the key product leaders of the studio, working closely with the Studio Director, Creative Director and the Production team to shape and execute the product vision for the game.
 You Will
 Define and refine the product strategy and roadmap in collaboration with the studio team.
 Own prioritization and planning across key product areas (core gameplay improvements, meta progression, monetization, LiveOps).
 Create clear product specifications for new features, improvements, systems and experiments.
 Build and manage the A/B testing roadmap and ensure data-driven decision making.
 Work closely with Game Design on progression, economy, balancing, competitive systems, player goals and long-term motivation.
 Collaborate with the Creative Director to ensure that product direction supports both the gameplay vision and business objectives.
 Partner with Analytics to monitor performance, understand player segments, diagnose problems and identify growth opportunities.
 Act as a decisive product leader with a General Manager mindset, taking ownership of product, business and team-level decisions.
 Balance strategic vision with hands-on execution.
 Profile
 5+ years of experience in product management or lead game design roles within the mobile gaming industry.
 Proven experience scaling mobile games, launching major features or improving key KPIs is a strong plus.
 Experience with action, PvP, competitive or skill-based games is highly valued.
 Hands-on game design experience (especially around progression, economy, balancing, or player motivation), would be a significant advantage.
 Strong experience working on live mobile games, ideally with midcore or hybrid-casual-to-midcore products.
 Deep understanding of F2P game loops.
 Proven track record of owning product strategy, roadmap, prioritization and feature delivery for successful mobile games.
 Strong hands-on approach with the ability to balance strategic thinking and day-to-day execution.
 Excellent analytical skills and strong experience making data-driven decisions.
 Experience defining and running A/B tests, interpreting results and translating insights into product decisions.
 AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work.
 Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence, align and convince stakeholders.
 Strong ownership, high energy, collaborative mindset and ability to handle broad responsibilities beyond a narrow product scope.
 Fluent in English.
 Benefits
 Best-in-class compensation
 Other benefits according to the country you reside

title: Project Manager for PLM & IoT System Solutions (m/f/d)
Program Manager – 3PL After Sales and Reverse Logistics
description:
As a Program Owner in the functional Last Mile Delivery Team, you will lead a core program with European scope to strengthen JD Logistics After Sales and Reverse Logistics capabilities, directly impacting customer experience. Your focus will be on:

title: Entrepreneur in Residence P&L Owner (m/w/d)
description:
Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut. Gerade gründest du nicht — aber du willst auch nicht zurück in eine Rolle, in der jemand anderes über Preis, Team und Ergebnis entscheidet. Dann ist das hier deine Rolle: Du übernimmst eines unserer validierten Ventures und führst es als eigenes Unternehmen. Mit Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung, ab Tag 1.
 Über hiiive 
 Wir sind eine AI-First Company mitten in Berlin. Engineering the Future of Intelligence — ROI on Controlled AI.
 Wir bauen AI nicht als Demo, sondern als kontrollierte, messbare Wertschöpfung: direkt mit Unternehmen wie Vaillant, Haas Fertigbau oder Telefónica — und über unsere eigenen Software- und Service-Lösungen. Um uns herum arbeitet ein Ökosystem aus Partnern, Spezialisten und Portfolio-Unternehmen.
 Wir entwickeln, validieren und skalieren neue Geschäftsmodelle selbst — von der Idee bis in den Markt, mit eigener Technologie, eigenen Daten und echten Kunden. Was an dem Punkt fehlt, an dem ein Venture trägt, ist der Mensch, der es führt. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.
 Aufgaben 
 Deine Mission 
 Du übernimmst ein bereits validiertes Venture und machst daraus ein Unternehmen, das eigenständig läuft: eigene Kunden, eigene P&L, eigenes Team.
 Du bist kein Berater und kein Ideengeber — du bist die kommerzielle Führung. Was verkauft wird, zu welchem Preis, mit welcher Marge und von wem: entscheidest du.
 P&L Ownership
 Volle Verantwortung für Umsatz, Kosten und Ergebnis deiner Einheit
 Pricing, Angebotslogik und Marge — inklusive der unbequemen Entscheidungen
 Steuerung auf Zahlen statt auf Gefühl, in monatlicher Taktung
 Reporting an die Geschäftsführung: Fortschritt, Engpässe, Learnings
 Umsatz & Kunden
 Du verantwortest den Umsatz deiner Einheit — Sales inklusive
 Die entscheidenden Gespräche führst du selbst: Enterprise-Deals, Verhandlungen, Verlängerungen
 Aufbau eines wiederholbaren Go-to-Market-Motions statt Einzelfall-Verkäufen
 Sobald es trägt: Aufbau des Vertriebsteams unter dir
 Betrieb & Team
 Aufbau und Führung des Kernteams — mit Zugriff auf unser Ökosystem aus Partnern, Spezialisten und Freelancern
 Verantwortung für Delivery-Qualität: was beim Kunden ankommt, verantwortest du
 Prozesse, die AI-first gedacht sind — nicht Prozesse, die AI nachträglich benutzen
 Zusammenarbeit bei hiiive
 Zugriff auf gemeinsame Ressourcen: Engineering, AI, Legal, Finance, Marketing
 Austausch mit den anderen Venture-Ownern im Portfolio
 Enge Taktung mit der Geschäftsführung
 Qualifikation 
 Was du mitbringst 
 Wir zählen keine Jahre. Uns interessiert nicht, wie lange du wo warst, sondern was du gebaut, verkauft und verantwortet hast — und wie du heute arbeitest.
 AI-First Arbeitsmodus. Du löst Probleme zuerst mit AI und erst dann mit Headcount. Das ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have, sondern die Voraussetzung.
 Du hast schon einmal Umsatz verantwortet — als Gründer, Geschäftsführer, Unit Lead oder in einer Rolle, in der die Zahl an dir hing.
 Du kannst verkaufen. Nicht „Sales steuern" — selbst am Tisch sitzen, verhandeln, abschließen.
 Du liest eine P&L und triffst danach Entscheidungen.
 Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Enterprise-Kunden: Fachbereich, Einkauf, Vorstand.
 Hohe Ambiguitätstoleranz — du brauchst keine fertige Struktur, du baust sie.
 Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.
 Gescheiterte Gründungen sind bei uns ein Plus, kein Makel — wenn du sagen kannst, woran es lag.
 Wen wir nicht suchen 
 Damit wir uns beide Zeit sparen:
 Niemanden, der vor allem eigene Ideen pitchen will. Wir bauen und validieren unsere Ventures selbst — deine Aufgabe ist es, sie zum Laufen zu bringen.
 Niemanden für Fundraising. Wir bauen aus dem Cashflow, nicht aus Runden.
 Keine reine Strategie- oder Analyserolle. Ein Deck ersetzt bei uns keinen Abschluss.
 Deine ersten 90 Tage
 Tag 1–30
 Venture, Zahlen und Kunden übernommen; eigene P&L-Sicht steht; erste Kundengespräche selbst geführt
 Tag 31–60
 Pricing und Angebot geschärft; Pipeline aufgebaut; erste eigene Abschlüsse
 Tag 61–90
 Wiederholbarer GTM-Motion definiert; Plan für Team und Delivery; belastbarer 12-Monats-Case
 Benefits 
 Was wir bieten 
 Echte Beteiligung an dem Venture, das du führst. Der Umfang hängt von Rolle, Timing und Beitrag ab — wir reden darüber offen im Prozess, nicht erst im Vertrag.
 Unternehmerische Verantwortung ab Tag 1 — nicht nach der Probezeit
 Ein validiertes Venture statt einer leeren Seite: Technologie, erste Kunden und Daten sind da
 Zugang zu unserem Ökosystem: Enterprise-Kunden, Partner, Engineering- und AI-Kapazität
 Der Weg vom EIR zum Geschäftsführer deiner Einheit ist bei uns der Normalfall, nicht die Ausnahme
 Attraktives Fixgehalt plus Erfolgsbeteiligung
 Ein kleines, ambitioniertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Wegen
 Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
 Kostenloses Gym direkt am Büro, regelmäßige Team-Events
 Büro in Berlin, hybrides Arbeiten nach der Einarbeitung möglich
 📩 Bewirb dich jetzt 
 Du möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen, Kundenwachstum aktiv vorantreiben und ein Team fachlich führen?
 Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf und kurzer Vorstellung.
 Werde Teil von dvision und gestalte die Zukunft von SEO und KI mit uns.

title: Founders Associate (m/f/x)
description:
konfetti ist die Buchungsplattform und Software für lokale Workshops. Seit der Gründung im April 2021 haben wir unser Produkt stetig weiterentwickelt und arbeiten nun mit mehr als 2.500 Anbietern zusammen. Insgesamt können wir über 12.000 Erlebnisse in Deutschland, Österreich und online anbieten.
 Dein next Step - konfetti! Als Founders Associate arbeitest Du direkt mit uns Foundern zusammen und bist da, wo entschieden wird. Du übernimmst eigene Themen, hältst uns den Rücken frei und lernst in kurzer Zeit mehr über den Aufbau eines Unternehmens als in den meisten anderen Jobs. Genau das macht die Rolle so spannend für Leute, die schnell wachsen und später selbst führen oder gründen wollen. 
 Werde Teil eines Weltklasse-Teams in unserem Berliner Büro mit office-first culture!
 Aufgaben 
 Den Foundern den Rücken freihalten: Du hältst uns operativ den Rücken frei und springst dort ein, wo es gerade brennt.
 Neue Initiativen angreifen: Du evaluierst, testest und baust neue Themen wie Corporate Gifting oder Retail als neuen Kanal eigenständig auf, von der ersten Idee bis zur Übergabe an das Team.
 Teams operativ unterstützen: Du packst aktiv mit an, vor allem in unseren Commercial Operations Bereichen (Vertrieb, Business Development, Partnerschaften).
 Prozesse besser machen: Du optimierst laufende Abläufe, treibst Automatisierungen voran und sorgst dafür, dass Dinge einfacher und effizienter laufen.
 Alles, was sonst so ansteht: Wir sind ein Startup, hier passiert viel. Stell Dich darauf ein, dass jeder Tag etwas anderes mit sich bringt.
 Qualifikation 
 Du hast einen sehr guten Studienabschluss, gerne von einer renommierten Hochschule.
 Idealerweise bringst Du 1 bis 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit, zum Beispiel aus Unternehmensberatung, Investment Banking, PE/VC oder einem High-Growth-Startup. Wenn Du weniger Erfahrung, aber echten Track Record und Drive hast, überzeug uns trotzdem.
 Du hast eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und willst richtig Gas geben. Reine 9-to-5 ist nicht Dein Ding.
 Du hast eine starke Affinität zu Zahlen und Automatisierung und stützt Entscheidungen gerne auf Daten.
 Du arbeitest strukturiert, übernimmst Ownership und bringst Themen auch bei Unklarheit eigenständig ins Ziel.
 Du bist eine offene und kommunikative Persönlichkeit, die gerne aktiv auf Menschen zugeht.
 Du willst im Büro arbeiten: kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, direkter Austausch.
 Deine Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch sind beide verhandlungssicher und fließend.
 Benefits 
 Vergütung 
 Attraktives Basisgehalt
 Mitarbeiteranteile an konfetti: Du bist Teil unseres Erfolgs
 Urlaub, der mitwächst: 25 Tage Basisurlaub + 1 Tag extra pro Jahr Zugehörigkeit (bis zu 30 Tage)
 Heiligabend und Silvester hast Du jeweils einen halben Tag zusätzlich frei
 Benefits 
 50% konfetti Mitarbeiterrabatt auf alle Workshops und Erlebnisse
 Exklusive Corporate Benefits & Rabatte bei zahlreichen Partnern
 Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket
 Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club
 Die besten Teamevents: wir sitzen mit tausenden tollen Events an einer unerschöpflichen Quelle 🎉
 Lernkurve & Verantwortung 
 Strukturiertes Onboarding mit unserer konfetti-Kanone und Deinem persönlichen Buddy, der Dich bei Deinem Start bei uns begleitet
 Learning & Development Program - gemeinsam meistern wir die Herausforderungen von heute und die Chancen von morgen
 Regelmäßige 1:1-Sessions und offene Feedbackrunden
 Eigenverantwortliche Projekte und Gestaltungsspielraum für Deine Ideen ab Tag 1
 Bewirb Dich noch heute! Bitte lade uns in einer Datei Deinen Lebenslauf, aktuelle Zeugnisse und ein kurzes Anschreiben hoch (insgesamt max. 20 MB).
 Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung und ein erstes Kennenlernen!

title: Founders Associate mit Sales-Fokus (w/d/m) - Jobbird.com
description:
Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Geschäftsführung und unserem Head of Business Development zusammen und unterstützt Enterprise-Vertrieb dort, wo er entsteht: im direkten Austausch mit Einkaufs- und Nachhaltigkeitsteams großer Industrieunternehmen. Du bist kein klassischer Account Executive: Als Founder's Associate mit Sales-Fokus verbindest Du Kundenarbeit mit Analyse und Strategie. Du analysierst Märkte und Accounts, bereitest Deals vor, führst zunehmend eigene Gespräche und baust das Daten- und Prozessfundament, auf dem unsere Revenue-Organisation wächst.
Tätigkeiten
 Deine Aufgaben
 Sales mit Gründer-Perspektive: Du recherchierst Zielaccounts, bereitest Discovery Calls und Pitches vor, führst zunehmend eigene Gespräche und begleitest Deals bis zum Abschluss. Wo es noch kein Playbook gibt, etwa bei neuen Produkten wie unserer Resource Use Analysis (ESRS E5, CRMA), in neuen Märkten oder bei neuen Buying Centern, hilfst Du, eins zu schreiben.
 Analyse und Business Cases: Du übersetzt Einkaufs- und Emissionsdaten von Kund:innen in belastbare Business Cases, rechnest Preismodelle durch und lieferst die Zahlen, mit denen wir verhandeln.
 HubSpot und Datenfundament: Du verantwortest die Struktur unseres HubSpot, von Pipelines, Deal-Stages und Properties bis zu Reports und Dashboards. Du sorgst dafür, dass Pipeline, Forecast, ARR und Renewals jederzeit belastbar sind.
 Governance und Prozesse: Du hältst die Governance unserer Vertriebsorganisation am Laufen (Qualifizierung entlang unseres Frameworks, Pipeline- und Forecast-Reviews, Übergaben an Customer Success) und machst sie besser, gerne mit AI-gestützter Automatisierung.
 Strategische Projekte: Du schärfst mit uns ICP und GTM-Szenarien, analysierst Wettbewerb und Märkte und bereitest Revenue-Reportings für Geschäftsführung und Investor:innen vor.
 Anforderungen
 Wir suchen ab sofort
 0 bis 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung, z.B. Aus Strategieberatung, einem Startup, Investment oder Analytics, und einen Abschluss in Wirtschafts-, Ingenieur- oder Naturwissenschaften
 Herausragende analytische Fähigkeiten: Du strukturierst unklare Fragen schnell, arbeitest sicher mit Daten, AI und Excel, und ziehst daraus klare Schlüsse
 Echte Neugier auf Vertrieb: Du hast Lust, vor Kund:innen zu stehen, gute Fragen zu stellen und zu überzeugen; erste Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt ist ein Plus, kein Muss
 Strukturiertes, eigenständiges Arbeiten: Du setzt Prioritäten selbst, hältst Prozesse ein, weil Du ihren Wert verstehst, und bringst Dinge zu Ende
 Akribie im Umgang mit Daten: Ein CRM voller Lücken stört Dich mehr als andere 
 Erfahrung mit einem CRM wie HubSpot oder die Bereitschaft, Dich schnell tief einzuarbeiten
 Interesse an Klimaschutz, Lieferketten und Einkauf
 Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift
 Lust auf IT-Tools, inklusive AI-gestützter Automatisierung
 Deine Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, für Deine Themen, für Deine Kund:innen und für das System, mit dem wir alle arbeiten
 Du suchst
 Eine steile Lernkurve: Du willst verstehen, wie ein Startup Enterprise-Kund:innen gewinnt, und das System dahinter mitbauen
 Vertrieb und Strategie in einer Rolle: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und siehst, wie Positionierung, Pricing, Produkt und Vertrieb zusammenhängen
 Vielfältige Aufgaben, von der Datenanalyse bis zum Kundentermin auf Management-Ebene
 Kund:innen, die wirklich einen Unterschied machen, weil sie einen großen Hebel haben, CO2 zu sparen, wie z.B. Siemens, Bosch, Bayer und TÜV SÜD
 Eine Rolle, die mit Dir wächst, je nach Stärken in Richtung Account Executive, Revenue Operations oder Business Development
 #Jobster

title: Senior Project Manager (m/w/d) – Kommunikationssysteme für kritische Infrastrukturen
description:
Job Description Summary
 Grid Solutions, ein Geschäftsbereich von GE Vernova, konzentriert sich darauf, Technologien und Fachwissen zu bündeln, um die schwierigsten Herausforderungen im Energiesystem zu lösen und den globalen Übergang zu einem widerstandsfähigeren und zuverlässigeren Stromnetz zu beschleunigen. Innerhalb von Grid Solutions liefert GE Lösungen für die Kommunikation kritischer Infrastrukturen. Diese Netzwerke sind sicher, flexibel und maßgeschneidert, um die Ziele und spezifischen geografischen Anforderungen der Kunden zu erfüllen. GE liefert Kommunikationslösungen für kritische Infrastrukturen mit Schwerpunkt auf EPC/Turnkey-Projekte in den Bereichen wie: Energie, Öl und Gas, Bergbau, Wasser/Abwasser und Transport, mit besonderem Fokus auf elektrische Infrastruktur und Grid Automation.
Der Senior Project Manager (m/w/d) ist verantwortlich für die Planung, Steuerung und vertragliche Abwicklung von Projekten von der Übergabe bis zum vorläufigen Abnahmezertifikat (PAC), wobei ein hohes Maß an Kundenzufriedenheit sowie ein maximaler Gewinn/Wert sichergestellt werden müssen. Der Projektmanager (m/w/d) ist dafür verantwortlich, Projekte unter Berücksichtigung finanzieller und operativer Aspekte wie Budget, technischem und vertraglichem Umfang, Ressourcen und Ausführungsplanung abzuwickeln. Er/Sie ist zudem verantwortlich für das Sicherheits-, Qualitäts-, Risiko- und Chancenmanagement, um die Kundenzufriedenheit sowohl intern als auch extern zu gewährleisten.
Der Senior Project Manager (m/w/d) wird ein Portfolio von 6–8 aktiven Projekten verwalten, darunter CCS- & DCS-Systeme (Schutz & Steuerung) sowie Dienstleistungen und Einzelprodukte, die parallel laufen.
 Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
 Job Description
 Steuerung der Projektausführung vom Angebot bis zum Ende der Garantiezeit, einschließlich FAT (Werksabnahmeprüfung), Lieferung und Inbetriebnahme.
 Anwendung von Best Practices im Projektmanagement (gemäß Projektmanagement-Handbuch und spezifischen Anweisungen der Produktlinie), mit besonderem Fokus auf Übergabeprüfungen, Projekt-Gate-Reviews und Projektabschluss.
 Beitrag zur operativen Leistung der Einheit durch präzise Prognosen zu finanziellen KPIs: Umsatz, Cashflow und Deckungsbeitrag.
 Primärer Kundenkontakt für die Vertragsabwicklung.
 Sicherstellung der Einhaltung vertraglicher Verpflichtungen gegenüber dem Kunden durch klare Rückmeldungen bei konsequenter Interaktion (z. B. Telefon, E-Mail usw.), Kundenmeetings, regelmäßige Reviews usw.
 Durchführung von Projekten in Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Engineering, Logistik, Beschaffung, Einkauf und Finanzen.
 Monatliche Aktualisierung des Fortschritts der Aktionspläne sowie der Umsatz-/Cashflow-Prognosen.
 Vorbereitung und Präsentation von Projekt-Reviews.
 Führung umfassender Dokumentationen und Aufzeichnungen der durchgeführten Projekte.
 Management der Ressourcenplanung und Arbeitsbelastung des Teams, um eine verrechenbare Quote von 90 % oder mehr zu gewährleisten.
 Führung von EHS-/Sicherheitsmaßnahmen und -leistungen: Vollständige Einhaltung der GE-Regeln und -Prozesse sowie Sicherstellung, dass Projektteams (eigene und untervergebene) ordnungsgemäß geschult sind und über die erforderlichen Qualifikationen verfügen.
 Unterstützung der Vertriebsteams durch das Teilen von „Lessons Learned“ (ROEs), die zu optimierten Projektkosten und Lieferzeiten führen.
 Implementierung einer Vertragsmanagement-/Änderungsstrategie im Interesse von GEV. Beitrag zum Unternehmenswachstum durch eigenständige Führung von Nachtragsangeboten (Variation Orders) für die jeweiligen Projekte bei Bedarf.
 Vorbildfunktion für die Führungsverhaltensweisen von GE bei der Wahrnehmung von Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten.
 Qualifikationen / Anforderungen
 Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektro-/Elektronik-/Telekommunikationstechnik von einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule o.ä.
 Branchenkenntnisse. Vorerfahrung in Telekommunikations-/Netzwerk- oder IP-Feldaktivitäten.
 Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement in einem EPC/Turnkey-Geschäft.
 Fähigkeit, ein Projektteam von 3–6 Personen zu leiten und zu motivieren.
 Fließende Deutsch-und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich
 Technische Kenntnisse in IP- oder MPLS- oder SDG-Protokollen, industrieller Drahtlostechnik, Schutzleittechnik, Router und Switch, Powerline-Carrier sind von Vorteil.
 Reisebereitschaft: 20 %.
 Was Wir Bieten
 Umfangreiche Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung.
 Flache Hierarchien sowie eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und Unternehmenskultur.
 Ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.
 Attraktive Vergütung auf Basis von außertariflichen Verträgen, einschließlich Jahresbonus und weiterer Sozialleistungen.
 Additional Information
 Relocation Assistance Provided: No
 This is a remote position

title: Remote Senior Product Manager, Provider Experience
Chief of Staff, AI Engineering - REMOTE
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
 About Lenovo
 At Lenovo, we are building the future of AI through Qira, our next generation AI platform powering intelligent, personalized, and secure experiences across PCs, smartphones, tablets, enterprise solutions, and future AI enabled devices. Our mission is to create AI that is context aware, multimodal, agentic, and seamlessly integrated across Lenovo’s global ecosystem.
We are looking for an exceptional Chief of Staff, AI Engineering to partner directly with the Executive Director of AI Engineering in driving strategy, execution, and operational excellence across Lenovo’s global Qira AI organization.
 Location: US Remote, Chicago, IL is highly preferred.
 About The Role
 This is a highly strategic leadership role for an experienced engineering operations and technical program leader who thrives in fast paced, high growth technology environments.
As the Chief of Staff, you will serve as the operational leader for the Qira AI Engineering organization, helping drive execution across our most critical initiatives, including Personal AI, Enterprise AI, User World Model, AI Research, and the Qira AI Platform. You will partner closely with engineering, product, design, research, legal, security, and executive leadership to ensure alignment, remove organizational obstacles, and accelerate delivery.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex organizational challenges, building scalable operating models, and leading large cross functional engineering programs.
 What You’ll Do
 Partner directly with the Executive Director of AI Engineering to execute the strategic vision and priorities for Lenovo’s global Qira AI organization.
 Lead execution of complex engineering initiatives across AI research, platform engineering, product development, infrastructure, and commercialization.
 Drive cross functional alignment across engineering, product management, design, research, security, legal, privacy, business, and executive leadership.
 Establish and continuously improve engineering operating mechanisms, including annual planning, quarterly business reviews, roadmap governance, release readiness, executive dashboards, and engineering metrics.
 Partner with engineering leaders to improve execution quality, engineering productivity, delivery predictability, and organizational effectiveness.
 Lead technical program governance across multiple global engineering teams and ensure successful execution of strategic programs.
 Identify execution risks, organizational bottlenecks, and cross team dependencies while driving rapid resolution.
 Develop executive presentations, strategic planning documents, engineering communications, and leadership updates for senior executives.
 Support organizational planning, budgeting, workforce planning, vendor management, and strategic investment decisions.
 Drive adoption of engineering best practices, AI governance, software development processes, and operational excellence.
 Represent the AI Engineering organization in executive reviews and cross functional leadership forums.
 Build scalable operational processes that enable the organization to grow rapidly while maintaining execution excellence.
 Basic Qualifications
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
 10+ years of experience leading large scale software engineering programs, engineering operations, or technical program management.
 Experience supporting senior engineering executives, CTOs, VPs, or Heads of Engineering.
 Demonstrated success delivering complex software platforms involving multiple engineering organizations.
 Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, cloud platforms, AI technologies, and large scale product development.
 Excellent executive communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
 Strong analytical and problem solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail.
 Experience managing globally distributed engineering organizations.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Master’s degree or MBA.
 Experience delivering AI, machine learning, cloud, enterprise software, or developer platforms.
 Experience building operational models for rapidly growing engineering organizations.
 Experience with engineering productivity, release management, engineering metrics, and organizational scaling.
 Strong familiarity with modern engineering tools including GitHub, GitHub Actions, Linear, Monday, Azure, Jira, and AI powered developer tools.
 Experience working within large global technology companies.
 Success in Your First 12 Months
 Establish a scalable operating model for Lenovo’s global Qira AI Engineering organization.
 Improve execution predictability and visibility across strategic AI programs.
 Build executive dashboards and engineering health metrics that enable data driven decision making.
 Strengthen plannin
